doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Thanks and goodbye
summary: Panken thanks him and Donaldson declines to give his X-rated ending.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Mr. Donaldson, thank you very, very much for this very candid two days of interviewing.
All right. I hope you got a little material to interest the people.
Can’t imagine how they wouldn’t be interested.
I can’t tell you my ending, because it’s X-rated, so I wouldn’t put it on there. - - - - - - [Transcribed by Ted Panken from a .wma file of the conversation.]
